origin: The first 24 raw fixtures and criteria are retained from the locally authored earlier draft; 8 new cases target method depth. No old run results are reused. Inputs and grading criteria must be materialized separately. Inherited literal newline escapes in fixture contents were normalized to real newlines; setup wording was made neutral and the mixed-WIP recipe is executable. Added 13 document-maintenance cases on 2026-09-20; prepared evaluator material, not executed model behavior. Added one legacy-status migration case after the user accepted the default lifecycle; prepared only.

# Import
API 写任务再发送队列；worker 扣额度，写完成状态，然后 ack。超时就重试，取消即认为任务已停止。
files.platform.md: 任务表在支持事务的数据库内。额度在独立服务上；其 debit 接口支持 tenant_id + operation_id 幂等键，键与扣款结果在额度服务原子保存，保留 7 天，可按键查询。队列可能重复和延迟投递；最长恢复窗口尚未约定。用户可以查看任务状态。
